title: Deciphering the structural and functional impact of missense mutations in Egr1-DNA interacting interface: an integrative computational approach.
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过整合致病性预测与分子动力学模拟，系统评估Egr1锌指转录因子DNA结合域错义突变对蛋白-DNA互作界面结构稳定性与结合能力的影响，精准聚焦TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上以MD模拟为核心，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Early growth response-1 (Egr1) is a zinc-finger transcription factor that plays a critical role in controlling cell growth, proliferation, differentiation, angiogenesis, and apoptosis. Egr1 is induced by many growth factors, cytokines, and stress signals and is also known to be involved in several pathological conditions like cancer, neurological and ocular disorders. The DNA binding domain of Egr1 is a highly conserved Cys2His2 (C2H2) zinc finger (ZNF) domain which specifically binds to GC-rich consensus sequence GcG (G/T) GGGCG and activates transcription. As the C2H2 domain specifically recognizes its DNA target, the mutations spanning this region shall perturb DNA recognition and may hinder transcription of target genes. Therefore, in this study, the missense mutations occurring specifically at the DNA binding domain (DBD) of Egr1 were probed by computational approaches involving in silico screening of pathogenic and functional mutants coupled with extensive molecular dynamics simulations, to determine the mutants that affect its structural stability and interactions with DNA. From the pathogenicity analysis of 38 missense mutations spanning Egr1-DBD, 17 were predicted as pathogenic, and 7 amongst these were found to have functional impact on Egr1. On combined analysis of molecular dynamics simulation, Residue interaction analysis and Egr1-DNA interaction analysis results, the mutants R371C and R375C showed least impact, whilst, H382R tend to increase the structural stability, whereas R360H, H390R, E393V, and H414Y conferred greater impact by altering the structural stability and DNA interactions. Hence, this study exposes the prospects of considering these 4 deleterious mutations for clinical significance, but needs further experimental validation.HighlightsEgr1's DNA binding domain is a highly conserved Cys2His2 (C2H2) zinc finger domain that specifically recognizes its DNA target.Mutations spanning in the DNA binding domain shall perturb DNA recognition and may hinder transcription.Among the missense mutations, mutants R360H, H390R, E393V, and H414Y were inferred to have a greater impact on Egr1 by altering the structural stability and DNA interactions.
abstract_zh: 早期生长反应因子-1（Egr1）是一种锌指转录因子，在控制细胞生长、增殖、分化、血管生成及凋亡中发挥关键作用。Egr1受多种生长因子、细胞因子和应激信号诱导，并已知参与多种病理状况，如癌症、神经系统及眼部疾病。Egr1的DNA结合域是一个高度保守的Cys2His2（C2H2）锌指（ZNF）结构域，该结构域特异性结合富含GC的共有序列GcG（G/T）GGGCG并激活转录。由于C2H2结构域特异性识别其DNA靶标，跨越该区域的突变将扰乱DNA识别，并可能阻碍靶基因的转录。因此，在本研究中，通过计算手段对Egr1 DNA结合域（DBD）中特异性发生的错义突变进行了探测，包括致病性和功能性突变体的计算机筛选，并结合广泛的分子动力学模拟，以确定影响其结构稳定性及与DNA相互作用的突变体。对跨越Egr1-DBD的38个错义突变进行致病性分析后，预测17个为致病性，其中7个被发现对Egr1具有功能性影响。综合分子动力学模拟、残基相互作用分析及Egr1-DNA相互作用分析结果，突变体R371C和R375C影响最小，而H382R倾向于增加结构稳定性，而R360H、H390R、E393V和H414Y通过改变结构稳定性和DNA相互作用产生了更大影响。因此，本研究揭示了将这4个有害突变视为临床重要性的可能性，但需进一步的实验验证。亮点Egr1的DNA结合域是一个高度保守的Cys2His2（C2H2）锌指结构域，特异性识别其DNA靶标。DNA结合域中的突变将扰乱DNA识别，并可能阻碍转录。在错义突变中，突变体R360H、H390R、E393V和H414Y被推断通过改变结构稳定性和DNA相互作用对Egr1产生更大影响。
